sgdb.enterKey: SteamGridDB: enter an API key to check it
sgdb.badCharacters: SteamGridDB: API key doesn't work (it contains spaces or hidden characters; copy it again)

igdb.enterBoth: IGDB: enter both the client ID and the client secret
igdb.rejected: IGDB: client ID or secret doesn't work (Twitch rejected them)
igdb.works: IGDB: client ID and secret work

ss.needDev: ScreenScraper: enter the developer ID and password too; PlayOut needs them to use ScreenScraper
ss.enterBoth: ScreenScraper: enter both your user name and password
ss.devWorks: ScreenScraper: developer ID and password work
ss.devRejected: ScreenScraper: developer ID or password doesn't work
ss.bothWork: ScreenScraper: login and developer credentials work
ss.userRejected: ScreenScraper: user name or password doesn't work

tgdb.enterKey: TheGamesDB: enter an API key to check it
tgdb.worksLeft: TheGamesDB: API key works ({left} requests left this month)
tgdb.worksUsedUp: TheGamesDB: API key works, but this month's request allowance is used up
tgdb.invalid: TheGamesDB: API key doesn't work (TheGamesDB says it is invalid)
tgdb.refused: TheGamesDB: the key was refused; it is wrong or this month's request allowance is used up

steam.badId: Steam: the SteamID64 must be the 17-digit number from your profile
steam.enterKey: Steam: enter a Web API key to check it
steam.rejected: Steam: Web API key doesn't work (Steam rejected it)
steam.enterId: Steam: Web API key works; enter your SteamID64 too
steam.noAccount: Steam: the Web API key works, but no account has that SteamID64
steam.bothWork: Steam: Web API key and SteamID64 work
steam.bothWorkPersona: Steam: Web API key and SteamID64 work ({persona})

ra.enterBoth: RetroAchievements: enter your username and Web API key to check them
ra.noUser: RetroAchievements: the Web API key works, but no user is named "{user}"
ra.rejected: RetroAchievements: Web API key doesn't work (RetroAchievements rejected it)

http.rateLimit: rate limit exceeded, try again later
